# Toggle

The one switch: an on/off setting, always in a ListRow's trailing slot.

`NomNom.Toggle` · Controls

## Use

```jsx
<NomNom.Toggle />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="NomNom.Toggle"></x-import>
```

## Notes

The one switch: an AppButton restyled as a track. Only ever a ListRow trailing slot.

## Props (ToggleProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` | `boolean` |  |
| `defaultChecked` | `boolean` |  |
| `onChange` | `(checked: boolean) => void` |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |
| `label` | `string` | Required when the row's title is not the accessible name. |
